lede: Wat Luang Ratchasanthan accounts for 74 catalogued manuscripts, 2 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Phayao (96% of the corpus for this temple), ahead of Mueang District. Nearly all (100%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to palm-leaf · ใบลาน (96%) over mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (4%). Dated witnesses run 1666–1948 CE (50 of 74 carry a date).
